title: Portuguese Seed Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with flavorful portuguese sausage and crunchy poppy seeds, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Cook the white rice according to package instructions.
Sauté the onion and garlic in olive oil until softened.
Add the portuguese sausage and cook until browned.
Stir in diced tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
In a separate bowl, mix poppy seeds and cheddar cheese.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of cooked rice.
Top with the sausage and tomato mixture, followed by a layer of poppy seed and cheese mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, finishing with a layer of rice on top.
Dot the top with olive oil and cover with hearty bread cubes.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
